universities.name: Heidelberg University
mfa_steps: Open the {portal} and sign in with your Uni ID.
Type a name, for example Laptop, and click "Weiter".
Take a screenshot of the QR code ({shot}) and drop or paste it here.{secret}
Click "Weiter", then "Testen". Type this code and click "Absenden".{code}
universities.notes: Tested end to end, see docs/e2e.md. The OTP form comes after the password form.

universities.name: ETH Zurich
universities.notes: Students: authgroup = "student-net", username_suffix = "@student-net.ethz.ch".

universities.name: University of Bremen
universities.notes: Without 2FA the second field stays empty, which uni-vpn cannot send yet. Checked 2026-10-19: the gateway lists two groups; Tunnel-All-Traffic (its default) reaches the library's e-books, Tunnel-Uni-Bremen only the campus.

universities.name: University of Marburg
universities.notes: Students: authgroup = "unimr-vpn-students-Passwort+2FA".

universities.name: Stanford University
universities.notes: The default group CardinalKey is SAML; the group Stanford is a password form with Duo.

universities.name: University of Stuttgart
universities.notes: Students type the whole name, st123456@stud.uni-stuttgart.de.

universities.name: University of Mannheim
universities.notes: Checked 2026-10-19: the gateway lists WebVPN and WebVPN-Split; only WebVPN reaches the library databases.

universities.name: University of Kassel
universities.notes: Needs a Windows client identity; the exact user agent is a guess.

universities.name: TU Dresden
universities.notes: Checked 2026-10-19: the gateway lists 12 groups, A-Tunnel-TU-Networks is its default. The user name is ZIH-Login@tu-dresden.de. ZIH moves its VPN to eduVPN, so this gateway may be switched off.

universities.name: Texas A&M University
universities.notes: Profile from the university's documentation, not tested. Full tunnel group: tunnel_all_traffic. Duo pushes automatically.

universities.name: University of Minnesota
universities.notes: Profile from the university's documentation (it.umn.edu/node/131921), not tested. vpn.umn.edu has no address; the Linux setup names tc-vpn-1.vpn.umn.edu, whose group list calls the split tunnel AnyConnect-UofMSplit ("UMN - Split Tunnel - General Access VPN Pool" is the Cisco client's profile name). Full tunnel group: AnyConnect-UofMvpnFull.

universities.name: University of Granada
mfa_steps: Open the {portal} and sign in. Choose "Doble Factor Autenticación para Servicios TIC UGR" and click "Generar nuevo token".
Take a screenshot of the QR code ({shot}) and drop or paste it here. Also scan it with the app on your phone.{secret}
universities.notes: Profile from the university's documentation, not tested. User name is the full address cuenta@ugr.es. Checked 2026-10-18: the gateway asks for a one-time code in its own field; the code generator is added under "Doble Factor Autenticación para Servicios TIC UGR" in the Oficina Virtual.
